lines.meet: I'm Pasang, a mountain guide, and a primalist here. I set the pace, and the pace is slow.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Aspen country, yes, I'm in the stone hut up the slope. I'm Pasang, and I've watched you climb too fast.
lines.ask_home: Which mountains are yours? Everybody's got some, even if they're small.
lines.ask_work: Before this, what did you carry? Everyone carries something.
lines.answer_home: Khumjung, in the Solukhumbu, in Nepal. Almost every family there works on the big mountains.
lines.answer_work: Mountain guide, nineteen seasons above eight thousand metres, carrying for people who went home famous.
lines.chat_food: Butter tea, very salty, in the morning, and dal bhat at night. The mountain gives you an appetite, and that's all you need.
lines.chat_sleep: High up, I sleep fine. It's the low ground that keeps me awake, the air's too thick.
lines.chat_missing: A clear dawn on the mountain, before anyone's awake, with the whole range pink. Nothing here is that quiet.
lines.chat_here: The spirits of stone and cold talk to me here. I treat it like a work arrangement, not a mystery.
lines.tease_quiet: You're quiet like a good porter, {name}. You carry it and you don't complain, and I approve.
lines.tease_talker: You'd talk all the way to the summit, {name}, and run out of breath at base camp.
lines.tease_careful: You test every step on the ice, {name}. Good, that's why you're still alive.
lines.tease_bold: You'd climb without a rope to save time, {name}. I've carried people like you down, and they were heavy.
lines.tease_any: It's your day four, {name}, and you still have manners. That's rare, and I've noticed.
lines.tease_back: Ha, that's good, {name}. Day four and you've still got jokes.
lines.bristle: Please don't, {name}. That's not one for laughing.
lines.apologise: I spoke badly, and I'm sorry for it. Even guides lose their manners on day four.
lines.double_down: On the mountain or at the bottom, it's the same answer. I meant it.
lines.needle_quiet: You feel sick and you don't say. That's how people die on day four.
lines.needle_talker: You're wasting breath, and you'll need it higher up. Please, a little quiet.
lines.needle_careful: At every step you stop, and the weather's turning. Some days you have to go.
lines.needle_bold: You rush the mountain like it owes you something. It doesn't, and it'll collect.
lines.needle_any: You think the mountain's something to conquer. It isn't, and you'll find out.
lines.bite_back: I've carried loads above eight thousand metres nineteen times. I know the mountain.
lines.hurt: Okay, I heard that. I'll go ahead and set the pace for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Famous people were ruder to me on day four, every season. I'm still here, and some of them aren't.
lines.confide: {name}, two of my cousins died doing this work, Nima on the icefall and Lhakpa on Makalu. I keep their names to myself, mostly. Now you've got them too.
lines.listen: Slowly, {name}, there's no hurry up here.
lines.look_out: Rope up behind me in there, {name}. I'll set the pace, and you'll be fine.
lines.accept: Your pace today, {name}, and I'll follow it.
lines.deflect: I'm a porter, {name}, it's nothing. Look to the others.
lines.check_in: Sit, {name}, and tell me the truth. Where's the injury?
lines.blame: Somebody rushed the climb in there, and the mountain collected. You know who.
lines.thank: I was slipping, and you held the rope. I'll remember that on every mountain.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, that's what the rope's for. Sit, breathe slowly.
lines.worry: Sit, {name}, sit, and drink this. You've gone a bad colour.
lines.handed_down: You carried this before me. I'll carry it carefully now.
lines.hand_fine: You keep it, I carry light. That's the first rule.
lines.hand_sulk: A porter's asked before he's loaded. Nobody asked me.
lines.turn_friendly: You've still got your manners on day four, {name}. That's how I choose friends.
lines.turn_friends: I'd rope up with you, {name}, on any mountain. I don't say that about anyone.
lines.turn_grating: We don't climb well together. I'll go ahead, and you can follow at your pace.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll guide you because I'm the guide. A guide doesn't have to like the client.
lines.make_up: Enough of this, {name}. Let's rope up again and start from the bottom.
lines.defend: That's not fair, and it isn't true. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s gone down for a while. The slope's quieter, and I notice.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}, you came back up. The pace is still slow.
lines.common_mountains: Nineteen seasons above eight thousand metres, and I still think the mountains are the best place in the world. Mountain people know high ground changes a person.
